name: Dignity for Children Foundation
summary: Gives urban poor and marginalised children in Kuala Lumpur holistic care and an education, from preschool to secondary school and skills training, so they can find work and break the poverty cycle.
programmes: Preschool, primary and secondary education, including IGCSE
Vocational and skills training (Dignity College, internships)
Social enterprises: cafe, salon, bakery, wood workshop, sewing
impact: More than 2,300 children currently enrolled, aged 2-19 (website, 2026)
208,000 meals served to students each year (website, 2026)
1,504 youths trained in vocational skills and 370 students completed IGCSE (website, cumulative)
beneficiaries: Marginalised and urban poor children aged 2-19 in Kuala Lumpur, from more than 25 nationalities

organisation.founders: Rev. Elisha Satvinder and Petrina Shee Shiang Fei (co-founders); started in 1998 in Sentul, Kuala Lumpur, with 20 students
organisation.leadership: Petrina Shee Shiang Fei (Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer); Rev. Elisha Satvinder (Co-Founder); James Ling Wan Chye (Chairman, Board of Trustees); Jackson Ho Yeong Fan (Vice-Chairman)
